final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), first_cut AS (SELECT ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - a.avg_count AS excess_first FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN first_average AS a WHERE ac.actor_count > a.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM first_cut) SELECT SUM(fc.actor_count) AS actor_count_sum, AVG(fc.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(fc.actor_count - sa.avg_count) AS avg_excess_second FROM first_cut AS fc CROSS JOIN second_average AS sa WHERE fc.actor_count > sa.avg_count
